plugins.name: ScreenDimmer
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Cover monitors with click-through overlays, or turn them off over DDC/CI.

plugins.name: ShortcutDetector
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Find taken and free global key combinations, and test a shortcut before you assign it.

plugins.name: LayoutKeeper
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Remembers which desktop and monitor each window is on, the taskbar thumbnail order and which window is in front, and restores them after a reboot.

plugins.name: WindowDeck
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Shows all windows of an app in a row above the taskbar, to pick, move and close them from the keyboard.

plugins.name: LanguageIndicator
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Shows which input language you switched to, in the middle of the screen.

plugins.name: WindowNamer
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Give any window a name of your own. The taskbar, Alt+Tab and the title bar show it, and it comes back after a restart.

plugins.name: QuickJump
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Pin windows to the digits and jump back to one from anywhere.

plugins.name: QuickActions
plugins.author: community
plugins.description: Windows tools in the palette: window size, dark mode, keep awake and more.
